reason: Only changes the jQuery UI i18n script path/version and removes CDN fallback for this one resource, which is low-risk but could break sites that relied on the old ~/OrchardCore.Resources/Scripts/jquery-ui-i18n(.min).js path or the CDN fallback if they referenced it directly rather than via the resource manifest name.
